name: 12637-decode-16bmoe-1gpu
hardware: 1x H100 80GB HBM3 (one GPU of an a3 node, --gres=gpu:1).
parallelism: TP=1, PP=1, DP=1. One engine on one GPU; no parallelism flag is passed, which is the engine default of 1.
architecture: sparse mixture-of-experts decoder (DeepseekV2ForCausalLM), 27 layers of which 26 are MoE, 64 routed plus 2 shared experts per MoE layer, 6 active per token, hidden 2048, 16 heads, bf16; 16B total parameters, 2.4B active, ~31 GB of weights. The checkpoint ships its own modelling code, hence --trust-remote-code.
load_profile: concurrent (closed loop), streams=1, warmup 25%, no cooldown, bounded at 40 requests with a 900 s safety cap. One stream is the declared operating point, not a sweep point. Seed static 12637.
workload: synthetic `synthetic_text`, fixed shape: 128 prompt tokens in, exactly 512 tokens out, min == max == mean on both, so the sampler cannot vary them. Sampling is temperature 1.0 / top_p 1.0 and ignore_eos is sent, so all 512 tokens are always generated.
purpose: A single-user coding assistant streaming 512-token completions from short prompts, one request at a time on one GPU.
launch:
# vLLM 0.7.1-era AsyncEngineArgs: an unknown key is a TypeError at engine construction.
# Do not add keys from a later vLLM.

model: deepseek-ai/DeepSeek-Coder-V2-Lite-Instruct
trust-remote-code: true

# Load-bearing, not cosmetic: the checkpoint's own window is 163840 with YaRN scaling, and
# sizing the KV cache for that would change how much of the GPU the weights compete with.
# The workload's worst case is 128 + 512 = 640 tokens.
max-model-len: 2048

tensor-parallel-size: 1
dtype: bfloat16
gpu-memory-utilization: 0.90
